title: Borromean Rings Question
exact_target: Can three individually unknotted loops, with noncircular shapes permitted, form the standard Borromean link?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1385 (GEOM-026). CC BY 4.0.
